reviews.title: Pay to Edit
reviews.text: The app offers the option to suggest an edit since local knowledge isn’t very easy for AI analysis to get right all the time but they only offer a select amount of replays for the dispatch audio. So when you’re trying to improve the app you have to pay to have unlimited listens for the audio in order to figure out what words are wrongly transcribed in the written log or title/location. Terrible design. I wasted my limited listens just trying to improve the app for others.

reviews.title: Can’t shut it off
reviews.text: This morning I looked at the phone and had a stack of notifications from this app, WAY too many to put up with normally. I went into notifications to reduce them and found Notifications are completely Off. I finally deleted the app since there was no other way to shut it up. O-well..

reviews.title: Do not pay!
reviews.text: Do NOT pay for this app in order to be able to hear any blurred or removed information (am not talking about birthdays or even names) like addresses, names of places, etc because you will be wasting your money! There is absolutely nothing different from the paid for version and the regular free version!

reviews.title: Worthless for timely updates
reviews.text: Frustrating and unhelpful unless you like reading a historical hodgepodge of incidents. Events from an hour ago randomly interspersed with those from a week earlier and today’s earlier. No good reason to check it when you hear sirens unless you like random posts.

reviews.title: Info supplied is often inaccurate or lacking in information Map locations showed often inaccurate
reviews.text: Inaccurate locations. Not much info. Annoying with inaccuricies

reviews.title: Important information way too late
reviews.text: Although I admit this does give accurate detailed and vital information, it is never at the time it’s happening. It’s usually about 10 to 12 hours later. My Phone had informed me that we had a flash flood starting about 24 hours ago. This app did not notify me about it until four hours ago. So it’s nice to catch up on Vitale news maybe, but it’s nothing like listening to a scanner or finding out why there are a bunch of sirens going on around your house.

reviews.title: It gets it wrong a lot
reviews.text: There seems to be two words that confuse the AI. There may be others. I really don't trust it 100% to provide timely information about what is happening. Not worth paying for.

reviews.title: Useless Garbage
reviews.text: This app is useless garbage.   It sends notifications that are hours or days late!!   It’s pointless to do that.  I deleted it. I hear calls as they happen on my scanner, then hours or a day later I get notifications from this app of things I’ve already heard about.   Even for people that don’t have a scanner, I would consider this app useless.  The developer NEEDS to REMOVE this app from the App Store!

reviews.title: Was great until redactions
reviews.text: Was great until recent update where most identifying information is redacted from both the transcript and the audio. It’s already hard to understand dispatch/radio calls but now add mistimed static and the often-incorrect mapping and I have no idea where the call is actually happening

reviews.title: Delete/ remove
reviews.text: Don’t like it.  Want to remove it.

reviews.title: Word 50/50
reviews.text: I have a iPhone 17e and it says good for iPhone but it let me know 3 hours after alert is sent out not up to date on quickly post on audio

reviews.title: Typically Late
reviews.text: Information typically hours or even days late.

reviews.title: No date sort function
reviews.text: As another user mentioned, no rhyme nor reason to the posting order; very confusing.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I was hoping to keep track of things going on in my neighborhood. The app doesn’t relay things in order. I could hear sirens and look on the app for recent activity and it will show 2 day, 1 week, 2 hours, four days, all in that order. No ability to filter by most recent. And it reads dispatch calls with AI. Half the responses are from local cities over 25 miles away from my location, even with location on. It’s like sifting through sand to find something.

reviews.title: Overdose
reviews.text: Is not true removed

reviews.title: Wrong Location
reviews.text: It’s keep sending me stuff from every county but my own. Smh

reviews.title: ai messes it up!
reviews.text:
because the app relies on ai summaries, many calls are listed as being in my town 
when they actually aren't.

reviews.title: Payment
reviews.text: DO NOT make a payment for this App. They charged my account much more than I expected!

reviews.title: Fails to open since last several updates.
reviews.text: This app use to open every time it was selected. Then suddenly I could not get it to open. I am at current iOS but unable to open since last couple of updates. Please fix the app so it works again when attempting to open screen doesn’t do anything.

reviews.title: Fake News
reviews.text: This app just makes up stuff about my town. None of it actually happens. Just a bunch of AI bull.

reviews.title: No dispatch radio Available
reviews.text: Yes I got the app hoping to have live dispatch radio from Albany Georgia. Despite multiple crimes including shootings, we get no radio. Also all the so called breaking crime news notifications I get and none of them are happening or happened in Albany GA. To bad because are local news and radio are totally ignore or just don’t report on major crime stories until days later and often very vague. Seems local politics also have power over CrimeRadar as well. I keep searching

reviews.title: Way out-of-area notifications
reviews.text: WHY does it waste my time with Notifications 100s of miles away?!  I’m in SF Bay Area and keep getting notifications for events in Los Angeles!  In fact, Comments for these L.A. events are from across the U.S.! This is NOT helpful!

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time
reviews.text: Three times in the last 3 months we have literally had police (and fire once) outside our front door and nothing was on crime radar. Glad it is a free app because it is awful.

reviews.title: Consumer
reviews.text: The problem is in my City our Radio Coms are hidden from public until after it has been Sanitized? You cannot  listen to Live PD any Longer while it’s happening because they are Digital and on frequency you cannot get!

reviews.title: AI marketing
reviews.text: I thought this app was amazing, the use of AI to comb through police radars is one of the interesting and beneficial uses of this technology. I am very offput however, by the recent influx of AI generated advertisements I’ve seen to promote this app. The fabricated stories are mostly inaccurate to the service provided by the app. Due to these AI ads, I no longer want to associate with the service.

reviews.title: Fake engagement/bait & switch
reviews.text:
I was an early CrimeRadar user. The developer said so. I earned lifetime free premium for that loyalty.
After a phone reset, Restore Purchase did nothing. The lifetime reward is gone. Erased.
You used early believers when this app was still dismissed as a spammy Citizen clone. Now that you are a major player, those same people are disposable. That is not a glitch. That is how you treat the customers who made you.
Lifetime meant lifetime. Restore it. Or admit the word was just bait.

reviews.title: How.. why?
reviews.text:
Consistently gives late notifications, no timely notifications.

Incorrect titles assigned, poor transcripts.

reviews.title: Per Trial Period
reviews.text: I expected way better, but what I got was much worse. Developers I left you several messages and reports and I have not heard back from you even once. You are not offering me the pro version because I am still getting nothing but static and I’m going problems with your app. Do you think that I would pay $80 a year for this is unthinkable. It needs much improvement and you can start with talking to the people who are writing you.

reviews.title: AI guided falsehoods
reviews.text:
I was sent a report from my dad, who found this app. It was what looked like a new article reporting that a body had been found, chipped in a million pieces, up the street from my home. 
 I found it very difficult to believe that this could happen in my neighborhood and nobody knew about it. 
 Next he sent me another, regarding my neighbors’ house having been reported for distributing drugs from an SUV at a time that we were all at home, outside, in clear view of the neighbors’ black suv. 
THEN I check out the app to find that every article has an AI disclaimer in tiny print, and that anyone reading it has the ability to change and edit the stickers. 
How do we shut down this app that preys on stupid people who don’t fact check?

reviews.title: Inaccurate AI
reviews.text:
I've recently tried out this app & like most, I initially believed it was providing helpful, real information. In less than a month it's already sent me a wildly inaccurate report, like my nextdoor neighbor's house on fire, etc. that is just flat out untrue. From what I can tell listening to the dispatch audio, it was 2 cities away, and on streets with names that in no way could be mistaken for what the AI reported in this app. 

It's interesting & slightly entertaining but don't trust it for reliable information you use for your safety.

reviews.title: Watch An Ad to Listen?!
reviews.text: It needs to be a whole lot cooler to require watching an ad or buying a membership to see things at the highest level. I pay for applications I use so that developers can keep making them better. Yours has a long way to go to prove it would be worth paying for. I won’t know though because I won’t watch an ad to see if you’ve made it better. Good luck.

reviews.title: Not that great
reviews.text:
The app tells you about things that are going on around you but everything on the audio on the pay site is so chopped up. You can hardly understand what’s going on. I enjoy knowing what’s going on around me, but it’s not worth paying for me.

Just download the app and read what’s going on near you cause you’re not gonna get anything about the audio.

Their beta tabs are just aged, honestly not sure how they picked these. They’re a week old and not updated often.

reviews.title: Most recent update removed the features I use
reviews.text:
I was really enjoying this app! I liked it so much that I pay for the monthly subscription.
This most recent update, removed the ability to sort by time and location
My saved locations are returning unexpected results. It appears the radius is no longer working in the configuration settings.
Needless to say, I am going to unsubscribe from premium.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money on the premium package
reviews.text:
Don’t waste your time buying the premium package because it doesn’t give you anything more than a nationwide view which you could already do by selecting locations. It’s just a scam. Nothing is in chronological order, you get alerts about everywhere, except for your followed locations. I don’t care about things that are happening 30, 40 or 100 miles away. I just wanna be able to get alerts about the locations and addresses that I put in as my followed location. 
  I only keep this app because it’s good sometimes but very rarely. And now they want you to pay to play the calls. Yep, Im officially done with this scammy money grab

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text: This was a good app but has gone down hill dramatically. No longer gives the town name, shows absolutely no incidence around my chosen location on the map but shows all other locations I don’t care about, you can only listen to a few broadcasts then it says you have to pay, the ai interruptions are way off, the calls are not in chronological order, etc. I would not pay for this app at all. It’s becoming useless.

reviews.title: Seriously?
reviews.text:
As a U.S. citizen, I'm concerned about the privacy and ethics of this app.

The app appears to collect public dispatch radio traffic, use AI to summarize it, and publish incident information before events are officially confirmed. Even if the audio is publicly available, many people may not realize their emergency calls can quickly become AI-generated summaries and map entries viewed by thousands.

Where is this data coming from? What safeguards are in place to prevent inaccurate AI summaries or misleading information? How are locations verified, and what measures exist to protect people's privacy during emergencies?

reviews.title: A pray button? Come on.
reviews.text:
This is the second time I’ve tried and deleted this app. First time it didn’t have enough sort or search options to make it practical for seeing why I hear sirens outside or whatever. They have added that now. 

The site has always been full of judgey, gossipy, next door types leaving religious comments on everything. And I guess that works for this app creator because they have recently added “Pray 🙏” as the first thing people can do on any post. 

I’ll be looking for a replacement that can keep me informed without evangelizing at me.

reviews.title: Wish list!
reviews.text: I like the app, but I hate how u have to scroll down to find the current dispatch calls, yes! The list is not in any order it goes from 2hr ago, jumps to 30 min ago, to 2days ago, to current and on and on and on!! Which is annoying and such a waste of time ! So by the time u find most updated calls, y oh ve missed a few and back to scrolling to find the newest dispatch call! I have it 4stars but after writhing my review I’m changing it to 2 as it’s more annoying now that wrote about this issue! I hope it’s fixed

reviews.title: I had high hopes…
reviews.text:
I had really high hopes for this app, but it’s missing way too many basic functions. For example - you can’t sort stories by most recent. I open the app when I hear sirens, and I can’t actually see that story for days afterward. But I’m seeing stories from 1 month ago. Also, I have my location set but I’m getting reports from places 8-10 hours away from where I live.

Update- we had an incident on my street involving a gun shot about 6 hours ago. That incident still doesn’t show in the app.

reviews.title: So close to 5 stars
reviews.text: They used to include the entire address of the scanner calls, and now they blur them out. I understand privacy, but then I just spend time going to the actual scanner call and finding it anyway. This isn't helpful at all because often times for my town, we get scanner calls on the app from different towns (like we get Main St calls from another town with Main St) that populate on the app. I used to listen to the full address to see if this was actually in the area. Also, the pinpoints aren't always accurate. That's another thing that showing the full address would help with. We have a highway that has pinpoints in the same area constantly--most recently, a 4 vehicle accident. I almost avoided this area, until a Facebook post revealed it was way on the OTHER end of the highway, about 7 miles north. They are also missing calls on here due to the pin point issue (like if we have Nelson St, a different town would get OUR calls if they also have Nelson St). Overall it's a 5 star idea of an app, and would've given 4 stars before they took the full address away. The pinpoints being inaccurate and not hearing the address defeats most of the purpose.

reviews.title: I don’t like the new changes.
reviews.text:
I used to truly enjoy using this app. Recently, ads have been added, and although I specify an area that I want to read about I get so many other areas that it is beginning to lose my interest. I specify the areas that I want to see, but I see many, many
 other areas. In the past, I would have rated this app as a five, but based on the recent changes, I read it as a two.

reviews.title: What changed?
reviews.text: I used to love it because I was able to stay up to date with crime or accidents happening in my tiny town. First it started reporting crime from a town about 30 minutes away with a similar sounding name, which was annoying but I get how it might get confused. But now it’s giving me sensationalized stuff from cities hours away like mom walks in on husband and adult daughter. Are you just going for clicks now? I will be looking for other apps if this continues.

reviews.title: Deleted the Updated App
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a while to get local updates since my little town doesn’t have many options for knowing what’s going on. I thought it the app was decent (better than nothing).. but it seems like the app has gone through some major changes recently and I HATE it now. Enough that I deleted my account and deleted the app. Since the updates, the app keeps showing me alerts for all over my state and everywhere other than local. I’ve changed my settings, updated my location and my location preferences and it still keeps showing me alerts for everywhere other than what I want. And now it’s wanting to charge a subscription fee. No thanks, the app went from somewhat helpful to completely worthless.

reviews.title: It’s ok, but has a major flaw
reviews.text: I live in a small town, and this app keeps putting incidents that happen under our town, when they are happening in some major city in another state. It keeps saying there’s shootings, major accidents and stabbings on this road here where there is literally one home, and in reality it’s an incident in Texas. We figured this out when it finally gave a cross street during one of the many incidents on this street.

reviews.title: Now full of ads and “listen” credits
reviews.text: I have loved this app and am so disappointed that it’s gone the way of everything else and is now pay to listen. I understand needing to monetize but having to watch ads in order to listen to scanner snippets takes so much value away from the user experience. I was ok with the new promotions shown in between call summaries. I’d have been willing even to buy the app outright to make it ad-free. But being constantly interrupted by ads makes this more hassle than it’s worth. This was my favorite app before and I recommended it to lots of people. Can’t say the same anymore.

reviews.title: Well… it finally happened
reviews.text:
App was definitely cool when I first downloaded it a couple months ago. I could excuse the AI occasionally capturing the wrong names of roads, but at least we had the actual audio to listen to. Now the AI gets it wrong and the audio is also AI. 

This latest update also introduced ads which are really terrible. I usually don’t mind most ads but the first ad is full screen as you open the app, then they show up disguised between reports. Just can’t do it anymore.

Thanks for the memories buddy, but I’m out.

reviews.title: User data is on this radar
reviews.text:
TL;DR- All your data including activity and info are given up by using this. Total privacy surrender isn’t free.

Full:
The biggest crime is how otherwise reasonable people can think that anything is free. This monitors everything about users- personal information, communication, location, all you do, say, see, etc on your device. Forever. You give permission by using it. They gather and sell to anyone. You can’t undo that.

Don’t believe me, just scroll down a bit on the AppStore page and it’s all right there under privacy practices. Compare to other apps and see that almost none require giving up so much. 

Why does it need to know everything? To make money of course. Nothing is free, only difference is how you pay. This degree of data demand is no different than an excessive monetary charge, except with money you can stop paying. Once info is given, its use can’t be controlled. Be aware.

reviews.title: Better location correction
reviews.text: The app is fine. It’s great but when you set it up for a certain location, you should be able to only get that location within that mile range not five counties over in that location is nowhere near what you have saved on your phone. It’s very irritating to find out the what’s going on at the location you did say and you’re having to go through five counties over just to get to the location you’re at.

reviews.title: Censorship
reviews.text: They censor every age, address, license plate number, and just about any number that is said will be censored. It’s worthless! If you want to know what’s happening and where, in your community you’re far better off finding an app that doesn’t censor what is normally public knowledge or information! I’ve reported it many times and they still do it. I could only imagine how many people would NOT buy a newspaper that censored who, what and where something happened! If you redact anything you think is important information, what use is it????

reviews.title: Needs Fixes
reviews.text: This app is a really great idea!! But there is many glitches that could be fixed. The notifications do not work. Since having the app I haven’t been notified once. It also doesn’t filter out other states and cities when you put a main location on your Home Screen. I also wish it put more recent events taking place above things that happened days ago. There’s no organization in the event timeline so it’s hard to see what’s actually happening now in real time. Fix these things and it’s an easy 5 stars!!
